description: This file contains unit tests for verifying version-tolerant numeric type conversions in Orleans serialization, including widening and narrowing conversions for various numeric types, with support for different .NET versions.

classes.name: NumericsWideningAndNarrowingTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing numeric type conversions in Orleans serialization, including methods for testing widening and narrowing conversions for various numeric types.

classes.name: ValueHolder<T>
classes.description: A generic class used as a wrapper for serializing and deserializing numeric values during tests.

classes.name: INumber<T>
classes.description: Interface defining numeric operations for various numeric types used in conversion tests.

classes.name: ByteNumber
classes.description: Implementation of INumber for byte type.

classes.name: UShortNumber
classes.description: Implementation of INumber for ushort type.

classes.name: UIntNumber
classes.description: Implementation of INumber for uint type.

classes.name: ULongNumber
classes.description: Implementation of INumber for ulong type.

classes.name: SByteNumber
classes.description: Implementation of INumber for sbyte type.

classes.name: ShortNumber
classes.description: Implementation of INumber for short type.

classes.name: IntNumber
classes.description: Implementation of INumber for int type.

classes.name: LongNumber
classes.description: Implementation of INumber for long type.

classes.name: FloatNumber
classes.description: Implementation of INumber for float type.

classes.name: DoubleNumber
classes.description: Implementation of INumber for double type.

classes.name: DecimalNumber
classes.description: Implementation of INumber for decimal type.

classes.name: HalfNumber
classes.description: Implementation of INumber for Half type, conditionally included for .NET 5.0 or greater.

methods.name: ConversionRoundTrip
methods.description: Performs widening, narrowing, and overflow tests between two numeric types.

methods.name: FloatConversionRoundTrip
methods.description: Performs floating-point specific widening, narrowing, and overflow tests.

methods.name: WideningRoundTrip
methods.description: Tests widening conversions for a pair of numeric types.

methods.name: NarrowingRoundTrip
methods.description: Tests narrowing conversions for a pair of numeric types.

methods.name: NarrowingOverflow
methods.description: Tests overflow scenarios during narrowing conversions.

methods.name: RoundTripValue
methods.description: Performs a round-trip serialization/deserialization test between two types.

methods.name: RoundTripValueDirectly
methods.description: Performs a direct conversion round-trip test.

methods.name: RoundTripValueIndirectly
methods.description: Performs an indirect (wrapped) conversion round-trip test.
